headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a twelfth flat day as 11.11 discounts run (Kie Raha 20% off, rated 4.9) and Mykonos Soft Hour goes on sale online.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily ratings flat vs yesterday and 4 Nov for all five brands: Alchemist 4.43, SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), Mykonos 4.26, Onix 4.17, HMNS 4.15. No product moved.
11.11 is live: Kie Raha 35 ml is 20% off (Rp239k) on SAFF's Tokopedia store with a 4.9 rating from 393 ratings; Watsons runs 11.11 bundles with Morfosia at Rp249k.
Body mists are a longevity weak spot: Cloud Mist Annabel Lee scores 4.7 but recent reviewers say the lychee scent fades within minutes to hours.
Weak projection recurs beyond Extraits: a community wear report puts SAFF (the scent) at 4–6 hours with modest sillage, and ILIAD reviewers say it needs many sprays.
Grey-market pricing: a third-party eBay seller lists Irai Leima at US$78, several times local price, with no authorised-reseller proof.

recommendations.text: Counter Mykonos Soft Hour during 11.11: push top-rated scents (Kie Raha, Xocolatl, Irai Leima, Troupe) with review highlights, and seed TikTok and Instagram creators so SAFF appears in 'viral' lists.
Align normal vs promo price messaging across website, Tokopedia, Watsons and Zalora so constant 11.11-style markdowns do not make 'normal' prices look inflated.
Set honest wear-time claims for Cloud Mists (e.g. 'refresh every 2–3 hours') and bundle a mist with its matching Extrait for layering.
Set clear longevity expectations per Extrait (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with S.O.T.B, Troupe, ILIAD and Cascavel.
Publish an official overseas-reseller list and a 'how to spot a fake' guide; run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder.
